cards.title: Particle's Radar Makes Podcasts Searchable for AI
cards.body: Particle launched Radar, a podcast intelligence platform that transcribes and analyzes over 130,000 podcasts. The platform makes conversations searchable on the web and accessible to AI agents via API and MCP.

cards.title: Perceptron Brings Visual AI to Factory Floors
cards.body: Ex-Meta scientists launched Perceptron with an AI model for machine navigation and visual intelligence. The platform helps machines understand their environment with in-depth visual analysis capabilities.

cards.title: Z.ai Confirms Authorship of Ox Alpha Model
cards.body: Z.ai revealed it's behind Ox Alpha, the open AI model topping benchmarks and leaderboards. The company plans to release the model weights soon.

cards.title: QueryStory Launches to Verify AI Query Outputs
cards.body: QueryStory emerged from stealth with $6 million in seed funding focused on AI transparency. The startup uses LLMs and cybersecurity expertise to make AI queries coherent and verifiable.

cards.title: Arga Labs Raises $10M for Enterprise AI Agents
cards.body: Arga secured $10 million seed funding led by General Catalyst with support from Box Group and others. The company is building better training methods for enterprise AI agents.

cards.title: Legato Emerges with AI Hearing Glasses
cards.body: Legato raised $12 million and unveiled Legato Frames, AI-powered hearing assistance glasses. The patented technology integrates hearing support directly into eyewear frames.

cards.title: Runable Raises $21M for AI Business Growth Agents
cards.body: Runable secured $21 million to develop AI agents that help businesses scale operations. The platform processed over 1 trillion tokens in 90 days from paying customers.

cards.title: Ringg Raises $10M Series A for Voice AI
cards.body: India's Ringg secured $10 million from Peak XV in Series A extension funding. The company is advancing voice AI technology beyond traditional phone calls.

cards.title: Generalist Robotics Reaches $3B Valuation
cards.body: Physical AI startup Generalist achieved a $3 billion valuation in new funding round. The company raised $200 million just months after hitting $2 billion valuation.

cards.title: Stability AI Raises $76M in Fresh Funding
cards.body: Stability AI, maker of Stable Diffusion, raised $76 million in new funding round. Total company fundraising now reaches $232 million.

cards.title: Anthropic Gives Claude Shared Memory Across Chats
cards.body: Claude Cowork now remembers user context across separate conversations and sessions. Users no longer need to repeatedly brief the AI on projects and preferences.

cards.title: Gamma Acquires Design Startup Lica
cards.body: Gamma acquired Accel-backed design startup Lica to strengthen its design capabilities. Lica co-founders will join Gamma's new research team.

cards.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño Chip Beats Inference Benchmarks
cards.body: OpenAI's Jalapeño chip demonstrated superior inference performance on SemiAnalysis' InferenceX benchmark. The chip achieved more tokens per user and higher throughput per kilowatt than current alternatives.

cards.title: Keenable Exits Stealth with $26M for Web Indexing
cards.body: Accel-backed Keenable launched with $26 million seed funding to index the web for AI agents. The platform creates specialized search indexes optimized for agent navigation.

cards.title: Particle's Radar Makes Podcasts Searchable for AI
cards.body: Particle launched a podcast intelligence platform that transcribes and analyzes over 130,000 podcasts, making conversations searchable on the web. The platform provides API access and MCP integration for AI agents to leverage podcast data.

cards.title: Perceptron Brings Visual AI to Factory Floors
cards.body: Ex-Meta scientists launched Perceptron with an AI model designed to help machines navigate physical environments. The system provides in-depth visual intelligence for industrial automation applications.

cards.title: Z.ai Reveals Its Ox Alpha AI Model
cards.body: Z.ai confirmed it created Ox Alpha, the mysterious open AI model topping benchmarks and leaderboards. The model weights are set to be released soon.

cards.title: Robot AI Brains Moving Beyond GPT-2 Era
cards.body: Robot bodies are waiting for their AI brains to advance to match their physical capabilities. The robotics industry is pushing toward more sophisticated AI systems.

cards.title: QueryStory Ensures AI Query Coherence and Reliability
cards.body: QueryStory emerged from stealth with $6 million in seed funding to improve AI query reliability. The startup combines LLMs with cybersecurity expertise to make AI responses more trustworthy.

cards.title: Arga Labs Raises $10M for Enterprise AI Agent Training
cards.body: Arga secured $10 million in seed funding led by General Catalyst to build better enterprise AI agent training systems. The round included participation from Box Group, Emergence, and other top investors.

cards.title: Legato's AI Hearing Glasses Exit Stealth Mode
cards.body: Hearing tech startup Legato unveiled Legato Frames, AI-powered hearing glasses integrating patented hearing-assistance technology. The company raised $12 million as it exits stealth.

cards.title: Runable Secures $21M for AI Agent Growth Platform
cards.body: Runable raised $21 million, betting AI agents can help businesses grow beyond just building them. The company reports 60-70% of its trillion-plus token usage came from paying customers.

cards.title: India's Ringg Advances Voice AI Beyond Phone Calls
cards.body: Ringg raised $10 million from Peak XV as part of its Series A extension. The Indian startup is pushing voice AI technology beyond traditional phone conversations.

cards.title: OpenAI Loses Top Data Center Executive
cards.body: OpenAI's data center exec departed as the company faces ongoing high-profile departures. The company recently reorganized its infrastructure organization to support scaling operations.

cards.title: Stability AI Raises $76M for Stable Diffusion
cards.body: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, secured $76 million in fresh funding. The company's total funding now reaches $232 million.

cards.title: Claude Now Remembers Your Preferences Across Chats
cards.body: Anthropic expanded Claude's capabilities with shared memory across chat and Cowork applications. Users no longer need to repeatedly brief the AI on projects and preferences.

cards.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño Chip Optimizes AI Inference
cards.body: OpenAI's custom Jalapeño chip achieved superior tokens-per-user and throughput-per-kilowatt on benchmarks. The chip is built specifically for fast inference at scale.

cards.title: Keenable Exits Stealth to Index Web for AI Agents
cards.body: Keenable raised $26 million to build a vast web search index designed for AI agents. The company is enabling intelligent agents to access and understand web data at scale.

cards.title: OpenAI's Head of Product Discusses Agent Strategy
cards.body: TechCrunch interviewed OpenAI's head of product Thibault Sottiaux about the company's AI agent direction. The discussion covered UX design and product strategy under Greg Brockman's leadership.

cards.title: AI Hedge Fund Situational Awareness Faces SEC Probe
cards.body: Situational Awareness, the star AI hedge fund, is now under SEC investigation via federal subpoenas. The fund rapidly declined from Wall Street prominence to regulatory scrutiny.

cards.title: Bill Gates Warns on Passing AI Safety Thresholds
cards.body: Bill Gates stated that AI has already passed critical danger thresholds and discussed implications. He advocates for responsible AI development approaches.

cards.title: AI Models Struggle With Standardized Intelligence Tests
cards.body: Researchers tested leading AI models on intelligence puzzles and games, revealing significant gaps. The tests show how machine learning has advanced while highlighting remaining limitations.

cards.title: IBM's Granite 4.2 Models Support Local LLM Trend
cards.body: IBM released its Granite 4.2 model line capitalizing on growing interest in locally-run language models. The models enable on-device AI without cloud dependencies.

cards.title: AI Won't Replace Radiologists, But Will Transform Jobs
cards.body: New analysis shows AI will dramatically change radiologist roles rather than eliminate them. The technology will shift focus toward higher-level diagnostic tasks.

cards.title: Apple Designs Desktops Specifically for Local AI Development
cards.body: Apple's new desktop computers are optimized for running AI models locally. The systems enable developers to build and test AI applications without cloud reliance.

cards.title: Stanford Study: AI Hits Entry-Level Jobs Hardest
cards.body: A Stanford study found that AI automation disproportionately impacts entry-level positions. The research suggests workforce disruption will be concentrated in junior roles.
